title: Background what-if solves stack onto the main solve with no per-cycle budget; B1 fails 2x on priced-switch installs
claim: With price tiles and the fuse advisor on, async_run_optimization runs the fuse what-if plus its steady pair (3 full solves) and the price tile (1 or 3) serially after the main solve in the same cycle, so on an install that prices duty switches the cycle's solver CPU reaches 793 reference solves (5 of 12 cycles over B1's 388; 526 with the worst cycle dropped) where the main solve alone peaks at 376.
mechanism: coordinator.py async_run_optimization tail: _best_effort_cycle_step(_maybe_run_fuse_advisor) -> async_simulate(steady=True) -> _await_optimize + whatif.steady_pair (two _held_solve) ; _best_effort_cycle_step(_maybe_refresh_price_tile) -> async_simulate (steady for the cap tile). Each is a full solve of the same configuration as the main one, so its cost scales with the main solve's (2-3x when cycling_cost > 0 and a duty-switch stop is learned), and nothing bounds, defers or spreads them by the cycle's CPU already spent.

evidence.unit: reference solves of solver thread CPU in the worst cycle (tiles_fuse_duty); B1 = 60 Pi-s = 387.7 reference solves at F=5
evidence.machine: box B1 container (4 vCPU, shared by three seats), CPython 3.14, OpenBLAS pinned to 1 thread
evidence.contention_note: load1 6.4-8.7 (two other compute seats on the box); expressed as a ratio to tests/stress.py:reference_solve taken in the same run (30.96 ms); an earlier run of the same arm read 806 ref solves and 7/12 cycles over (load1 8.7)
evidence.tolerance: ±15 % (two runs: 24.54 s and 26.77 s host for the worst cycle)

instrumented_symbol: heatpump_optimizer.optimizer:_multi_start_minimize (entries) and heatpump_optimizer.optimizer:optimize_in_process (thread CPU per job, tagged at heatpump_optimizer.coordinator:_await_process by the submitting coroutine: async_run_optimization / _maybe_run_fuse_advisor / steady_pair / _maybe_refresh_price_tile)

perturbation.change: price_tiles_enabled True -> False and main_fuse_amperes 20 -> 0 on the same priced-switch install (arm tiles_fuse_duty -> arm duty)
perturbation.observed_value: worst cycle 792.8 -> 376.5 reference solves; cycles over B1 5 -> 0; msm entries per cycle max 14 -> 4

metric_definition: Sum over one _async_update_data of the thread CPU of every optimize_in_process job it submits, divided by tests/stress.py:reference_solve's CPU; B1 bound = 60 s / (F=5 x reference).
phenomenon_property: A cycle's total solver CPU (main solve plus every background what-if it triggers) stays within B1 whatever optional advisors are on; background what-if solves are budgeted against the CPU the cycle already spent, not run unconditionally after it.
seam_rule: grep -n 'async_simulate(' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py  # the background callers inside the cycle (_maybe_run_fuse_advisor, _maybe_refresh_price_tile) and whatif.steady_pair's two _held_solve

null_control.value: duty arm (same install, no background what-ifs): worst cycle 376.5 ref solves, 0/12 over B1; default arm (no duty pricing, no background what-ifs): 140.4, 0/12; tiles_fuse without duty pricing (run 1): worst 7.32 s host = 36.6 Pi-s, 0/12
null_control.note: the effect vanishes when the background what-ifs are off, so the overrun is the stacking, not the main solve

reproduction_steps: Run the command; read tiles_fuse_duty.cycle_max_ref_solves, .cycle_max_drop1_ref_solves, .cycles_over_b1_by_ref and b1_budget_ref_solves; compare duty.* (the perturbed arm).
Per-cycle series: tiles_fuse_duty.cpu_series_s vs .main_cpu_series_s shows the background share per cycle (cycle 0: 24.54 s total, 3.48 s main).
Leave-one-out cells are the 12 cycles of tiles_fuse_duty, in reference solves (min 5.18 s/30.96 ms = 167.5).
proposed_fix_scope: coordinator.py async_run_optimization's background tail: run at most one background what-if solve per cycle (fuse advisor and price tile alternate, steady pair spread over later cycles), or skip/defer them when the cycle's main solve already spent more than a share of B1; a stress-style check over the tiles+fuse+duty install.
